_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Session B1. (1) OLMo-7B-hf again, probe and h1b_rest: session O1's OLMo runs are void — its tokenizer appends <|endoftext|> to every prompt, the model took the document as finished and answered every one of 2,748 queries with the same unrelated text; completion prompts are now sent without that token (src/hf_llm.py encode_prompt; the other five tokenizers are untouched, checked on logged prompts). (2) Block B, the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct / T-lite-it-1.0 pair: Qwen's h1b_rest (its probe ran in O1: iris 84/142), and T-lite's probe and h1b_rest. ruadapt-Qwen follows in the next session. Planning figures from the validated src/price_plan.py (every answer to its budget, x 1.15; actual/plan 0.71-0.94 over 29 runs): OLMo probe 1.0 h, OLMo h1b_rest 3.0 h, Qwen h1b_rest 3.4 h, T-lite h1b_rest 3.4 h, T-lite probe 1.2 h; 12.0 h over two cards, the longer card 6.8 h by the dispatch order below (7.4 h if the runs fall the other way), about 7.5-8 h of session with downloads; O1's runs took 0.71-0.79 of their figures.
attached_input: none: the canon is fetched and hash-checked from its registered sources
